episodes.175801: Cold Pacific Storm System Produces Urban Flooding and Heavy Mountain Snow.

events.narrative: Palm Springs Police Department closed North Indian Canyon Drive through the Whitewater wash due to water over the road, with the closure reported at 4:26 PM and December 11, remaining closed through 1 PM on December 12. The Riverside County Mountains reported 1-2 inches of rain prior to the closure, and Palm Springs reported 0.23 inch.

Hail of pea size (0.25 inch) to 0.5 inch in diameter, with hail covering the road on Coronado. Accidents reported on Highway-75 between Nab Coronado and Leyte Road on the Silver Strand (Beach Highway). One vehicle flipped.
